sourceScope: 13 current runtime/test paths, ten production and three tests, uncommitted candidate relative to exact822f
reviewedContracts: One shared display preference owner; only explicit marked select change persists the separate display record. No child navigation, virtual controls, profile, save, working draft or iframe access in the display adapter.

Pageshow reconciliation reads current owner twice across a cancellable task; owner refresh listener precedes it. Failed-save local intent and warning remain owned; pagehide/dispose cancel pending repair.

Last-Undo focus repair is synchronous and requires original Undo focus, disabled final button, foreground visibility and no newer active element; only existing visible enabled actions are eligible. Undo content restoration and child preview identity are unchanged.

Live geometry now clears when pending/unavailable and filters nonfinite/empty rectangles. Text claims measured boxes only. Explicit snapshot is retained and marked stale on reload; no simulation or requested dimensions are mutated.

Map diagnostics render textContent, preserve parent disclosure, expose individual signal/hangar records, and use unchanged core defaults. Editor canvas cell geometry and pointer transforms are unchanged.
Existing display surfaces no longer own Practice text size; host notice deliberately has no later cosmetic-copy attribute that could replace an unsaved warning.
limits: Read-only source/static and retained receipt review. No tests, builds, browser, remote or source/index mutation.
61 tests per runtime are prior candidate results with original logs rehashed, not new executions or a final source full-suite claim. Prior128 cohort not added to these counts.
Actual history observations report new child sessions; they do not prove BFCache. Modeled persisted-return tests remain a separate evidence class.
No physical controller/touch or 200 percent zoom qualification. Native logs explicitly leave naturally nonempty offscreen live-control evidence outside their scope.
New diagnostics use complete English fallback for uk-UA; this subphase does not deliver a Ukrainian translation catalog.
Review covers current thirteen runtime/test paths; guidance/version/release/public acceptance are root-owned separate gates.
